title: Mg(BrO$_{3}$)$_{2}$ $\cdot$ 6H$_{2}$O ($J1_{10}$) Structure
comments:
This is the modern form of the \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B6C6D_cP60_205_c_d_d_a-001}{Zn(BrO$_{3}$)$_{2}$ $\cdot$ 6H$_{2}$O ($J1_{10}$)} structure, with the locations of the hydrogen atoms specified.
